🛑 **Do not touch anything. Step away from the panel.**

A warm connector with a burning smell means something is wrong electrically. This job is now on hold and flagged for a human technician to review.

**What to do right now:**
- Leave the panel alone
- If you smell smoke or see discolouration/melting, call an electrician immediately
- Don't close the panel door tightly — let it air out

A person will follow up on this job. Stay safe. 🙏
